criteria.name: Acceptance Criteria and Component Tests
criteria.description: Every AC- has component tests verifying behavior and error states.

scale.3: 100% of story ACs covered with automated component tests including error states.
scale.2: All happy path ACs tested, minor edge test missing.
scale.1: ACs untested or tests lack assertions.

criteria.name: API Contract and Typed Client Adherence
criteria.description: Strict conformance to openapi.yaml. Never calls endpoints outside the contract.

scale.3: Exact match to OpenAPI contract using typed client; all HTTP error responses handled.
scale.2: Adheres to contract, minor omission in client-side retry for 5xx.
scale.1: Calls uncontracted endpoint or drifts from parameter types.

criteria.name: All Screen States Handled
criteria.description: Loading, empty, error, success, and no-permission states are completely handled.

scale.3: All screen states gracefully handled with explicit UI feedback.
scale.2: All main states handled, empty state slightly plain.
scale.1: Missing error or loading state causing visual glitch.
scale.0: Unhappy paths unhandled, uncaught exception on error.

criteria.name: WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility
criteria.description: Semantic HTML, keyboard navigable, visible focus, alt text, passing automated a11y checks.

scale.3: Full WCAG 2.2 AA compliance: semantic tags, labels, keyboard operable, passing automated scan.
scale.2: Compliant, minor focus outline styling adjustment needed.
scale.1: Missing input labels or non-semantic interactive div elements.
scale.0: Completely inaccessible via keyboard or screen reader.

criteria.name: Mobile and Responsive Layout
criteria.description: Responsive layout without horizontal overflow down to 360px viewport.

scale.3: Clean responsive behavior tested from 360px to 1280px+ viewports.
scale.1: Horizontal scroll bar or element clipping on mobile.

criteria.name: Lint, Types, and Green Tests
criteria.description: TypeScript compiler clean (0 errors), linter clean (0 warnings), tests passing.

scale.3: Zero TypeScript errors, zero linter warnings, 100% green tests.
scale.1: TypeScript error or broken unit test.
